entries.title: Psalms 54:1
segments: ¶<To the chief music-maker; on Neginoth. Maschil. Of David. When the Ziphites came and said to Saul, Is not David keeping himself secret among us?> Let your name be my salvation, O God; let my cause be judged by your strength.

entries.title: Psalms 54:2
segments: Let my prayer come before you, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

entries.title: Psalms 54:3
segments: For men who are going after me have come out against me, violent men are purposing to take my soul; they have not put God before their eyes. (Selah.)

entries.title: Psalms 54:4
segments: ¶See, God is my helper: the Lord is the great supporter of my soul.

entries.title: Psalms 54:5
segments: Let the evil works of my haters come back on them again; let them be cut off by your good faith.

entries.title: Psalms 54:6
segments: Freely will I make my offerings to you; I will give praise to your name, O Lord, for it is good.

entries.title: Psalms 54:7
segments: Because it has been my saviour from all my trouble; and my eyes have seen the punishment of my haters.
